purpose: List supporting reasons or linked qualities.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain or polite clause + し; repeat for additional reasons.
This shop is inexpensive and also close to the station.
I am tired, among other things, so let us go home today.
He is kind and also careful in his work.
formation: Plain or polite clause + し; repeat for additional reasons.
restrictions: Often implies other supporting reasons beyond those named.
mistake: Noun predicates need だし or ですし.
